skills.name: godot_character_body_controller
skills.skill: Implement robust kinematic character controllers for 2D and 3D scenes using CharacterBody2D and CharacterBody3D with floor detection, acceleration, deceleration, and custom gravity handling.
procedure: Instantiate a CharacterBody2D or CharacterBody3D root node with a dedicated CollisionShape2D or CollisionShape3D.
In GDScript, read project gravity using ProjectSettings.get_setting('physics/2d/default_gravity') or 'physics/3d/default_gravity'.
Accumulate input axes via Input.get_vector() inside _physics_process(delta).
Apply gravity to velocity.y when not is_on_floor(), handling vertical terminal velocity limits.
Calculate horizontal velocity using lerp() or move_toward() against target speed based on acceleration and friction constants.
Invoke move_and_slide() without parameters (Godot 4+ operates directly on the velocity property).
Handle post-movement state checks such as is_on_wall(), is_on_floor(), or get_last_slide_collision().
verification: Run headless headless physics integration test: `godot --headless --run-tests` or execute scene with automated input simulation.
Confirm character lands on collision geometry and sets is_on_floor() to true within expected delta frames.
Verify velocity does not infinitely accumulate when grounded.
pitfalls: Passing velocity as an argument to move_and_slide() (deprecated Godot 3 syntax; in Godot 4, velocity is a built-in property).
Multiplying horizontal acceleration by delta twice when using move_toward() combined with move_and_slide().
Failing to account for up_direction when handling sloped terrain or custom gravity vectors.
skills.benchmark_prompt: Write a GDScript CharacterBody3D script that supports 8-direction movement relative to camera orientation, jumping with variable jump height, coyote time, and slope clamping up to 45 degrees using Godot 4.7 physics API.

skills.name: godot_animation_tree_state_machine
skills.skill: Configure and control an AnimationTree using AnimationNodeStateMachine, blend nodes, and AnimationMixer hooks for reactive character animation.
procedure: Attach an AnimationPlayer and an AnimationTree node beneath the character root.
Set AnimationTree.anim_player pointing to the AnimationPlayer NodePath and assign an AnimationNodeStateMachine as the tree_root.
Define state nodes (Idle, Run, Jump, Fall) and wire transitions configured with switch_mode (Immediate, AtEnd, Sync) and advance_condition or advance_expression.
Set AnimationTree.active = true.
In GDScript, obtain the playback controller via: var playback = animation_tree.get('parameters/playback') as AnimationNodeStateMachinePlayback.
Drive travel states using playback.travel('StateName') or update parameters dynamically using animation_tree.set('parameters/BlendSpace2D/blend_position', vector).
verification: Check that animation_tree.is_active() evaluates to true at runtime.
Assert playback.get_current_node() transitions correctly under programmatic stimulus.
Ensure missing animation warnings do not populate the push_error or engine error logs.
pitfalls: Setting AnimationTree.active to true before assigning the anim_player target path causing runtime initialization failure.
Calling playback.travel() with invalid node names causing silent state stalls.
Modifying blend parameters directly on the Resource instead of via the AnimationTree instance parameter paths.
skills.benchmark_prompt: Create an AnimationTree state machine configuration in GDScript that blends a 2D locomotion blend space (walk/run/strafe) into an upper-body aim blend via AnimationNodeBlend2, handling transition to a jump state via AnimationNodeStateMachinePlayback.

skills.name: godot_3d_procedural_ik_modifier
skills.skill: Implement procedural bone transformations and inverse kinematics using SkeletonModifier3D derivatives such as ChainIK3D, AimModifier3D, and BoneConstraint3D.
procedure: Ensure the mesh has a valid Skeleton3D node with properly named bones.
Add a SkeletonModifier3D node (such as ChainIK3D or AimModifier3D) as a direct child of the Skeleton3D node.
Configure modifier target properties, root bone name, and tip bone name via inspector or GDScript initialization.
For AimModifier3D, assign the forward axis vector, target node path, and rotation limits.
Set modifier.active = true to register the modifier into the Skeleton3D evaluation pipeline.
Update target Node3D positions or transforms dynamically during _process() or _physics_process().
verification: Query skeleton.get_bone_global_pose(bone_idx) before and after modifier evaluation to confirm non-zero delta towards the target.
Confirm modifier node is an immediate child of Skeleton3D, which is required by the SkeletonModifier3D architecture.
Check console for cyclic dependency warnings or bone name resolution errors.
pitfalls: Placing SkeletonModifier3D outside the direct hierarchy of Skeleton3D, causing it to remain inert.
Using legacy Godot 3/early 4 SkeletonIK3D patterns instead of the updated SkeletonModifier3D workflow.
Modifying bone poses manually in _process while a modifier is active without synchronizing execution order.
skills.benchmark_prompt: Set up a 3-bone procedural arm chain in Godot 4.7 using ChainIK3D under a Skeleton3D node to track an arbitrary moving 3D target with joint constraints and fallback pose handling.

skills.name: godot_grid_navigation_astar
skills.skill: Implement 2D and 3D discrete grid pathfinding using AStarGrid2D and AStar2D/3D with obstacle marking, heuristic tuning, and path smoothing.
procedure: Instantiate AStarGrid2D() and assign region Rect2i, cell_size Vector2, and diagonal_mode (e.g., DIAGONAL_MODE_AT_LEAST_ONE_WALKABLE).
Call astar_grid.update() to allocate internal structures.
Iterate over environment obstacles or tilemaps and flag non-walkable coordinates with astar_grid.set_point_solid(grid_pos, true).
Query path trajectories via astar_grid.get_point_path(start_coord, end_coord) or get_id_path().
Transform discrete grid coordinates back into global world-space coordinates.
For dynamic obstacles, update point solid states and clear previously cached paths.
verification: Assert astar_grid.is_in_bounds(pos.x, pos.y) returns true for valid domain queries.
Verify a path from start to goal avoids all coordinates flagged with is_point_solid(coord) == true.
Benchmark path generation execution time to ensure < 1ms budget for standard grid sizes (e.g., 128x128).
pitfalls: Querying points or setting solids before calling astar_grid.update().
Failing to offset world-space positions by half cell size, leading to path alignment issues on tile edges.
Confusing cell coordinate indices with world positions.
skills.benchmark_prompt: Construct a GDScript utility class wrapping AStarGrid2D that synchronizes with a TileMapLayer, supports dynamic obstacle reservation, and computes smoothed world-coordinate paths with diagonal movement penalties.

skills.name: godot_polyphonic_audio_pipeline
skills.skill: Build a pooled dynamic sound effects and music management system using AudioStreamPolyphonic, AudioServer bus routing, and AudioStreamPlayer nodes.
procedure: Create an AudioStreamPlayer node and assign an AudioStreamPolyphonic resource to its stream property.
Set the polyphony property on AudioStreamPolyphonic to define maximum concurrent voices.
Start the player with audio_player.play() in _ready() to acquire the playback handle.
Obtain the polyphonic playback reference: var playback = audio_player.get_stream_playback() as AudioStreamPlaybackPolyphonic.
Spawn one-shot sounds by calling playback.play_stream(audio_stream, from_offset, volume_db, pitch_scale).
Retain returned voice IDs if dynamic modulation, volume changes, or early stopping via playback.stop_stream(voice_id) is required.
Route output to custom audio buses configured in AudioBusLayout for real-time effects like filters and reverbs.
verification: Assert playback.is_stream_playing(voice_id) is true immediately after playback initiation.
Check AudioServer.get_bus_peak_volume_left_db(bus_idx, channel) to verify audio activity on the designated bus.
Verify no voice starvation or memory leaks when triggering high-frequency concurrent sounds.
pitfalls: Calling get_stream_playback() before the AudioStreamPlayer has called play(), resulting in a null reference.
Exceeding the pre-allocated polyphony limit, causing older voice dropping or audio glitches.
Instantiating new AudioStreamPlayer nodes per sound effect instead of leveraging AudioStreamPlaybackPolyphonic.
skills.benchmark_prompt: Develop an AudioManager singleton in Godot 4.7 using AudioStreamPolyphonic that manages multi-channel SFX playback, priority voice-stealing, pitch variance, and dynamic low-pass filter bus modulation.

skills.name: godot_compositor_custom_post_process
skills.skill: Implement custom viewport post-processing effects using the Godot Compositor and CompositorEffect API interacting with RenderingServer and RenderingDevice.
procedure: Create a custom resource inheriting from CompositorEffect.
Override _init() to configure effect_callback_type (e.g., EFFECT_CALLBACK_TYPE_POST_TRANSPARENT).
In _render_callback(effect_callback_type, render_data), obtain the RenderingDevice via RenderingServer.get_rendering_device().
Retrieve the scene buffers through render_data.get_render_scene_buffers().
Access render targets/color buffers using the render scene buffer API.
Bind compute pipelines or custom raster shaders to apply image manipulation (e.g., custom blur, chromatic aberration, or color grading).
Create a Compositor resource, attach the custom CompositorEffect to its compositor_effects array, and assign it to WorldEnvironment or Camera3D.
verification: Verify shader compilation passes without spirv/GLSL errors via headless log check.
Confirm _render_callback executes per-frame when attached to an active Camera3D / WorldEnvironment.
Validate that the rendered viewport reflects color buffer modifications without GPU driver crashes.
pitfalls: Modifying render targets without matching formats or resolving MSAA buffers when enabled.
Performing heavy allocation inside _render_callback instead of caching pipelines and uniform sets during initialization.
Omitting synchronization barriers when reading from and writing to the same viewport texture.
skills.benchmark_prompt: Write a CompositorEffect GDScript class in Godot 4.7 that sets up a compute shader pass during EFFECT_CALLBACK_TYPE_POST_TRANSPARENT to apply a vignette and grayscale post-processing effect to the primary 3D viewport.
